assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Japanese vocabulary card, batch 01 feedback round 2
Primary request: Image 1 is the edit target. Rotate the basketball's surface pattern into a natural slightly tilted three-quarter view. Replace the straight central plus sign and mirrored panels with off-center seam intersections and curved, diagonally wrapping basketball seams. Visibly unequal panel widths: a broad panel toward the viewer, narrower receding panels to one side. Keep the ball circular, orange, the same approximate size and position, white background, dark-purple exterior stroke and simple cartoon style. No motion lines, logos, text, or extra objects.
Updated card specification:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square vocabulary illustration for a Japanese listening game
Style/medium: simple flat cartoon, rounded natural silhouettes, solid fills, clean smooth dark-purple exterior outlines; understated charm. No gradients, 3D, watercolor, paper grain, sketch marks or photorealism.
Palette: ink #3f2468, pink #ff85b5, orange #ff9d47, yellow #ffe178, lavender #af86ef, sky blue #91d7ed, green #a6dbad, warm skin #ffcf9c. White and neutral gray allowed. Factual colors such as flags and named colors override decorative palette.
Scene/backdrop: plain solid white, opaque background, no frame or rounded card border.
Composition/framing: square canvas, primary subject centered and fully visible, typically 65–75 percent of canvas; generous margin. Context is subordinate. Maintain legibility at 145px.
Line system: rounded caps and joins; exterior stroke approximately 7 units on a 256-unit canvas. Keep apparent line weight consistent across single and grouped subjects, simplify detail for small groups; no hairline details below one pixel at 145px.
Constraints: literal recognizable subject, accurate anatomy, exact quantities. No answer captions, translations, decorative badges, logos, watermarks, shadows or unrelated props. Only render text/numerals if explicitly essential to the subject, character, quantity, calendar or factual sign. An attractive mnemonic is not proof of an unambiguous meaning.
Primary request: One orange basketball, slightly rotated and shown from a natural three-quarter angle. Keep a round silhouette, dark-purple outline and recognizable basketball seams. The seam intersections sit off-center; broad curved seams wrap around the sphere with unequal visible panel widths, one diagonal equatorial seam and no front-facing mirrored cross. A lively understated pose without motion marks. Centered full ball on white, no branding.
Role-specific scene above takes priority over a grouped review recommendation that also describes another card.
User feedback for shared designs (takes priority over obsolete appearance descriptions; retain the intended subject and action):
Shared ball design: an orange basketball with dark-purple exterior outline and basketball seams, viewed at a slight three-quarter angle. Use offset seam intersections, curved diagonal wrapping and unequal visible panels rather than a head-on mirrored cross. Reuse its appearance for ordinary toy/sports balls; preserve intended size, count and spatial relations. Keep specifically implied baseballs, beads, marbles, yarn balls and small jar counters appropriate to their own scene.
Preserve the approved collection's illustration style. Render one square illustration.

references.role: edit target: preserve orange basketball style; change seam perspective

assets.visualReview: Basketball seams wrap diagonally with off-center intersections and unequal panel widths; circular orange silhouette and purple outline retained.
